name: office-live-mcp
description: Drive live, open Word, Excel and PowerPoint documents via Office.js — edits appear in real time.
long_description:
Office Live MCP lets Claude control live, open Word, Excel and PowerPoint documents on macOS and Windows through Office.js APIs. Unlike file-based solutions, this extension manipulates the document in real time, and you watch every change happen.

**Capabilities:**
- PowerPoint: 27 tools — inspect decks, edit shapes and text, raw OOXML access, charts, screenshots, speaker notes
- Excel: 32 tools — read/write ranges, formulas, formatting, worksheets, tables, charts, data validation, comments
- Word: 26 tools — paragraphs, styles, search and replace, tables, comments, tracked changes
- Plus an execute_officejs/execute_exceljs/execute_wordjs escape hatch per host

**How it works:**
The extension runs a local bridge server that connects to an Office add-in via WebSocket. The add-in must be installed into the Office apps (one-time; see the project README for the setup command).

tools.description: Execute arbitrary Office.js code in the live document
